description: For each AI app and personal key connected to your Barmaan account: its access level, which capabilities it was granted, calls in the last 24 hours and when it last ran. Also returns the capability library and what no connection can ever do. Removing a connection's edit access is only possible on the website (Portal, MCP permissions); this tool is read-only.
name: portal_mcp_permissions_get
title: What my connections may do
